cases.description: Two sections with task IDs, auto IDs (including a no-ID task chained across sections), dependencies, weekday exclusion, durations, status tags, and a milestone. The explicit date range demonstrates the default exclusive end.
cases.source:
```mermaid
gantt
title Release readiness
dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
axisFormat %a %d
excludes weekends
todayMarker off

section Planning
Kickoff :milestone, done, kickoff, 2026-07-06, 0d
Specification :done, spec, 2026-07-06, 3d
Review :active, crit, review, after spec, 2d
Approval :crit, approval, after spec review, 1d
No ID chained task :1d
Explicit range :range, 2026-07-06, 2026-07-09

section Delivery
Implementation :active, impl, 2026-07-09, 4d
Verification :done, qa, after impl, 1d
Quick check :short, after qa, 4h
Minute check :minutes, after short, 30m
Next week :week, 2026-07-13, 1w
Release :milestone, release, after minutes, 0d
Cross-section no-ID chain :1d
```

cases.description: HH:mm parsing, generated IDs and previous-task starts, hour/minute/day/week durations, and the default today marker under a fixed browser clock.
cases.source:
```mermaid
gantt
title Clock units
dateFormat HH:mm
axisFormat %H:%M

section Clock
Hour span :hour, 09:00, 1h
Minute span :minute, after hour, 30m
Day span :day, after minute, 1d
Week span :week, after day, 1w
No ID chained task :2h
```

cases.description: Explicit end-date behavior when inclusiveEndDates is enabled.
cases.source:
```mermaid
gantt
title Inclusive date range
dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
axisFormat %b %d
inclusiveEndDates
todayMarker off

section Range
Three-day duration :duration, 2026-07-06, 3d
Inclusive explicit range :explicit, 2026-07-06, 2026-07-09
```
